other_conditions: Applicant must be an adult woman
Must belong to a poor household and not have an existing LPG connection in the household
Should be eligible as per SECC 2011 list
Should be a beneficiary of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
Should be a forest dweller or belong to Most Backward Classes (MBC) or Tea and Ex‑Tea Garden Tribes
People residing in river islands must submit a supporting document
If not covered by the above categories, must claim eligibility under a poor household by submitting a 14‑point declaration as per prescribed format
Special facility is provided to migrant families
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive a subsidised LPG connection (Rs. 1600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder or Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder) along with the first LPG refill and a free stove.
